significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) representational law: in pretrained single-cell models, “embedding geodesic distance” tracks lineage distance, branch points match known bifurcations, and a “low-curvature ‘pseudotime’ direction” aligns with differentiation rather than batch variation. These linked geometric relations constrain what should be observed across developmental systems more than a generic decodability claim, although the proposed ablation only shifts embedding position and therefore does not establish that the representation causally controls biological fate; PAGA and scVelo show that topology and directionality are meaningful lineage quantities, while Geneformer and scGPT motivate their use as foundation-model representations. A negative result would usefully rule out this particular intrinsic-geometry account of pretrained embeddings, but not developmental information encoded in another geometry, and the compound, partly qualitative wording permits mixed outcomes despite true and false being broadly distinguishable. In the topic-substitution check, deleting the specific distance, branching, and directional relations leaves only the assigned question about scientific mechanisms, which would not justify this score; the added specificity places it modestly above the topic median.

reach.justification: The concrete handles are “correlation between embedding geodesic distance and lineage distance,” detected “branch topology,” and alignment of the “pseudotime direction” with RNA velocity; these are primarily post-hoc diagnostics because they require known lineage or velocity references rather than forecasting fate before it occurs. After re-extraction on another model, the conclusion predicts transferable relations—distance correspondence, bifurcation topology, and directional alignment—not merely that some unspecified model-specific direction might be found, although the gene-program ablation itself would require rediscovery and only promises an embedding shift. The hypothesis is phrased across single-cell foundation models such as Geneformer and scGPT and across differentiation systems, so its likely downstream users include model evaluators and biological foundation-model developers, but it does not yet hand experimental biologists an independently validated fate-control intervention. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this reach score: without the quoted geometric metrics and relations, the broad topic supplies no comparable auditing handle.
